assessment_scope: Code, frozen protocol and pre-training data-provenance readiness review only. No model inference or held-out results were read; no frozen pipeline was changed. Training completion and final measured performance were not assessed here.

readiness.regulatory_determination: not assessed; no authorization or approval claim

current_data_context.legacy_target: Four supplied augmented-image labels, not verified CDR clinical stages
current_data_context.legacy_patient_independence: not established; patient and original augmentation-family identifiers unavailable
current_data_context.original100_role: historically reused descriptive model-reader benchmark; strict-manifest matches 66 train / 9 validation / 25 test images

implemented_protections.protection: Separate four-stage and binary clinical heads; MCI excluded from binary scoring; untrained stage-only clinical head is not evaluated.
implemented_protections.limit: Does not validate the source clinical labels or establish clinical staging.

implemented_protections.protection: All slices of a supplied clinical source subject remain in one split; prepared legacy pixel/dHash groups remain in one new split; original100-connected and mixed-label groups excluded from new training.
implemented_protections.limit: Source IDs are not a verified cross-repository patient crosswalk; coarse dHash is not patient identity. Old baseline similarity exposure remains.

implemented_protections.protection: Six fixed condition/seed runs, validation-NLL checkpoint rule, finite epoch budget, guarded resume, frozen pre-evaluation preference, original100 and other test data excluded from fitting/selection.
implemented_protections.limit: Completion and execution provenance must still be verified; software guards cannot prove nobody viewed outcomes outside the guarded path.

implemented_protections.protection: OpenNeuro remains outside fitting and checkpoint selection, with separate source/split reporting.
implemented_protections.limit: Only one AD case, unresolved source overlap, and both sources inspected while preparing preprocessing. Not robust external clinical validation.

implemented_protections.protection: All seeds and raw curves retained; case-aligned reader comparisons; paired hash-group/image intervals and clinical subject denominators with exact intervals.
implemented_protections.limit: Conditional intervals omit training/source uncertainty; fixed readers do not represent a population of neuroradiologists.

implemented_protections.protection: Finite pixel, dimension, source-join, source-subject split and gross image-rendering checks with frozen preprocessing history.
implemented_protections.limit: Not validated skull stripping/registration or radiologist QC; no deployed modality or out-of-distribution rejection gate.

planned_or_unfinished_checks.check: Finish or transparently account for all six runs; freeze preference before one-pass evaluation; verify local retrieval/checksums; report all outcomes and class regressions.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.success_evidence: Complete run provenance, raw curves, frozen selection/evaluation, all-seed uncertainty analysis and independent input/output digest checks.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.restriction: No tuning or new winner selection using held-out performance.

planned_or_unfinished_checks.check: Acquire approved original MRI with source-person linkage and matched clinical labels; reconcile overlap before reserving clinically relevant cohorts/sites/scanners entirely outside development.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.success_evidence: Verified source-subject/visit grouping, nonoverlap audit, prespecified endpoint and adequate class/subgroup counts to support the planned uncertainty analysis.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.restriction: Repository names and more slices do not establish independence or adequate sample size.

planned_or_unfinished_checks.check: Prespecify age, verified sex/gender, site/scanner/protocol and other relevant supported subgroups; report missingness, confidence intervals and all failures, including quality and excluded/rejected cases.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.success_evidence: Clinically meaningful subgroup denominators and source-specific error analysis on frozen independent evaluation data; clinically justified acceptance criteria specified before looking at results.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.restriction: Do not infer missing demographics or claim subgroup equivalence from sparse groups.

planned_or_unfinished_checks.check: For a future frozen model version, fit any calibration method and confidence/abstention rule using appropriate independent development/validation data only; evaluate on newly reserved untouched cohorts.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.success_evidence: Frozen calibration/decision rule; reliability and proper scoring measures; selective risk versus coverage; subgroup/source behavior; explicit handling of uncertain or unsupported inputs.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.restriction: Current softmax plus argmax is not calibrated confidence. No automatic abstention or validated numeric threshold exists. Do not tune these components on the current held-out results.

planned_or_unfinished_checks.check: Define the supported clinical T1 acquisition/protocol, orientation, resolution and quality requirements; verify provenance/metadata and reject unsupported modalities, corrupt/poor-quality inputs and incompatible processing.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.success_evidence: Clinician-reviewed input specification, detectable failure conditions, tested rejection behavior and transparent rejection counts on representative data.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.restriction: Existing RGB image loading does not identify MRI modality or prove anatomical adequacy. T2/FLAIR, CT and arbitrary screenshots are not supported by this clinical T1 experiment.

planned_or_unfinished_checks.check: Assess repeat scans and clinically plausible changes in acquisition/quality/preprocessing, with ranges chosen on development data and reviewed for anatomical validity.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.success_evidence: Prespecified paired consistency and failure analysis, alongside genuinely source-heldout clinical data.
planned_or_unfinished_checks.restriction: Synthetic corruption/software tests can diagnose sensitivity or implementation errors; they do not establish real-world clinical robustness.

clinical_readiness_blockers.blocker: An operational clinical intended use, intended population, supported inputs, reference standard and acceptable failure costs have not been established. Legacy stage labels and source AD/CN are different endpoints.
clinical_readiness_blockers.required_milestone: Clinical collaborators define the use and independently adjudicate appropriate MRI-linked clinical labels, timing, ambiguous cases and data quality; freeze clinically justified performance and failure criteria before evaluation.

clinical_readiness_blockers.blocker: Legacy patient independence is unknown, original100 is reused, the primary old/new comparison has observed similarity exposure, and the external pilot has only one AD participant.
clinical_readiness_blockers.required_milestone: Larger approved clinically representative, source-heldout and person-grouped cohorts with verified labels/overlap and sufficient class counts for the prespecified precision goals. Existing benchmarks remain exploratory evidence.

clinical_readiness_blockers.blocker: Age/source confounding, cross-cohort identity overlap, heuristic preprocessing, absent modality rejection and untested scanner/population shifts remain unresolved.
clinical_readiness_blockers.required_milestone: Clinician/radiologist review of preprocessing and failure cases; independent source/subgroup/quality evaluation; validated input and uncertainty handling without claiming unseen-category recognition from softmax.

clinical_readiness_blockers.blocker: No prospective silent evaluation or evaluated human workflow is established by this work. A fixed three-reader image benchmark is not prospective clinical decision performance.
clinical_readiness_blockers.required_milestone: After retrospective gates are met, qualified clinical partners oversee a prospective silent evaluation in the intended workflow without directing patient care, with prespecified failure capture, adjudication, drift monitoring and human review before any clinical deployment decision.

milestone_rule: A claim may advance only when its matching evidence is verified; completed epochs, better training curves, bigger GPUs, extra augmented images, software tests or a favorable historical benchmark alone cannot satisfy a clinical-readiness milestone. No numeric acceptance threshold or sample-size target is invented here.
